name: Imagifly
liveDescription: Imagifly is a platform designed to simplify the AI image generation process. It provides a well-organized system of customizable keywords, enabling effortless and rapid creation of unique prompts for AI tools such as Midjourney, Dall-E, or Photoshop.
descriptionZh: Imagifly：AI 设计工具站。用 AI 直接生成或辅助产出，免费可用，另有付费升级。
